decision: PROPOSE exact existing stats-banner VALUE receipt; no product edit performed
earliest_cause: The S9-A model.hidden_size VALUE consumer now emits model/model_hidden_size_value obligations in a registered receipted scope. Its registry routes name parser IR/embed and params authors, but those paths do not emit an actual renderer receipt for the displayed scalar. Existing per-layer/projector receipts are intact; the extra unmet obligation is the width scalar. Switching consume to consume_decision does not fix the downstream emission.

actual_saved_display.scope: Actual saved26 data; not a28 reproduction
Actual saved26 data; not a28 reproduction

proposed_scope: Add one exact ProjectionRoute for model/model_hidden_size_value to HTML structural target stats_banner.hidden_size, node_ids=(stats_banner.hidden_size,), projection_kind=field, projector_symbol=renderers.html.sections._stats_banner. These are a logical address for the existing cell; no new HTML attribute or drawing is required. Keep scope/join validation blocking.

Emit inside _stats_banner only after it appends the actual Hidden stat cell. Use the canonical ir.hidden_size scalar that supplied that cell, never fact_rows value. Cite only the evidence status from the original render-context fact row, through receipts_from_projects; let the render context stamp its own token.

Bind receipt issuance to a visibly numeric, lossless emitted cell: raw scalar must be an exact int (not bool), and the actual text placed in uf-stat-val must equal its ordinary comma-formatted integer spelling. A missing/placeholder/approximate/changed cell must not acquire a success receipt. Alternatively decode the exact rendered numeric text and hash that displayed scalar so a changed rendering fails the fact join. Do not merely assert that a HIDDEN label is somewhere in the page.

Use current_render_context and note_facts_projected in the same pattern as the existing layer-map emitter; declare only model.hidden_size. This is VALUE exposure, not embedding execution, shape propagation, parameter geometry or a connection proof.

If diffusion construction_summary replaces Hidden with Stages/Weighted modules, no Hidden receipt is emitted from that banner. Any actual obligation not drawn there remains a concrete finding unless a separately audited existing exact scalar surface receipts it. Do not add a family/name exception or invent a scalar card.

Keep existing parser routes and raw-consume debt thresholds unchanged in this bounded correction; no need to re-author a model fact or normalize output. Review any truly stale routes separately if the lawful route census requires it.
required_tests: The two failed actual-chain tests must pass with one new canonical width HTML receipt; existing projector/schedule targets remain exact.

Explicit root and nested text_config supplying paths close the same displayed scalar through their real consumption events, fact and context-stamped receipt. Sparse default retains class_default and no checkpoint path.

Different rendered scalar versus fact cannot pass: mutate canonical IR or rendered numeric text while retaining the fact; join must report mismatch or missing receipt. Equal labels alone cannot clear the obligation.
Omit the actual Hidden item or return a placeholder/noninteger cell: no Hidden success receipt. Missing or foreign fact/context, wrong route/projector/node identity remain rejected.

Compare standalone HTML before/after at each witness: this correction changes only receipt/event metadata, no stat text/order/layout. Preserve literal UUID differences separately; no blanket normalization or self-bless.
limitations: Read-only source and saved-data review. No model/test/runtime, no producer correction, no route approval/blessing implied. Parent owns next implementation decision.
